    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0]
    bgs=[x[0] for x in cnt.most_common(1)]
    fc=bgs[-1] if len(bgs)>1 else bgs[0]
    F={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if inp[r][c]==fc}
    rs=[r for r,c in F]; cs=[c for r,c in F]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    # interior fill
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1):
            if inp[r][c]!=fc: out[r][c]=4
    # gap runs per side
    sides={
        'left':[(r,c0) for r in range(r0,r1+1)],
        'right':[(r,c1) for r in range(r0,r1+1)],
        'top':[(r0,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)],
        'bottom':[(r1,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)],
    }
    for name,wall in sides.items():
        gaps=[p for p in wall if p not in F]
        if not gaps: continue
        d={'left':(0,-1),'right':(0,1),'top':(-1,0),'bottom':(1,0)}[name]
        for gr,gc in gaps:
            rr,cc=gr+d[0],gc+d[1]
            while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and inp[rr][cc]!=fc:
                out[rr][cc]=4
                rr+=d[0]; cc+=d[1]
        if len(gaps)>=2:
            gg=sorted(gaps)
            dirs={('left'):((-1,-1),(1,-1)),('right'):((-1,1),(1,1)),
                  ('top'):((-1,-1),(-1,1)),('bottom'):((1,-1),(1,1))}[name]
            for g,(ddr,ddc) in zip([gg[0],gg[-1]],dirs):
                rr,cc=g[0]+ddr,g[1]+ddc
                while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and inp[rr][cc]!=fc:
                    out[rr][cc]=4
                    rr+=ddr; cc+=ddc
    return out
